title: Ali's Hobbies
text:
My name is Ali. I like sports very much. On Monday, I play football with my friends. We play in the park after school. I am a good player.

My sister likes music. She plays the piano every day. She also likes to swim. On Sunday, she swims in the pool with our mother. They are very happy.

questions.text: What sport does Ali play with his friends?
What does Ali's sister play every day?
What can we guess about Ali's sister?
options: She does not enjoy her hobbies
She has many hobbies and likes them
She is too busy to swim

questions.text: What can we guess about the sister on Sunday?
options: She has a fun day with her mother

vocabulary.definition: games or physical activities that people do for fun or exercise
a person who takes part in a game or sport
a place with water where people swim

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Sporu çok severim. Pazartesi günü arkadaşlarımla futbol oynarım. Okuldan sonra parkta oynarız. Ben iyi bir oyuncuyum.
Kız kardeşim müziği sever. Her gün piyano çalar. Ayrıca yüzmeyi de sever. Pazar günü annemizle havuzda yüzer. Onlar çok mutlu.
